text:
Predicates:
RosesGivenOut(x) ::: roses are given out on TV on day x.
Time(x, y) ::: event x occurs at time y.
OnTV(x) ::: x is on TV.
Show(x) ::: x is a show.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad(x) ::: x is Breaking Bad.
Monday(x) ::: x is Monday.
8pm(x) ::: x is 8 pm.
Roses(x) ::: x is a rose.
GivenOut(x, y) ::: x is given out on y.
Premises:
∃x ∃y ∃z (Monday(x) ∧ 8pm(y) ∧ Roses(z) ∧ GivenOut(z, x) ∧ Time(z, y)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (Roses(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
Roses(breakingBad) ∧ Time(breakingBad, 8pm(x)) → Monday(x) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
